receipts.by: builder lane C (claude subagent), for Vandor's review
receipts.what: A copy of a 3-track file with two tracks dropped is flagged 'expected 3 audio streams, found 1' and nothing else; the whole file passes with titles, frame count 180, 160x90@30 and I -20 within 0.2. A file with 1.5 s of black, a 3 s frozen tail and audio that stops at 4 s gets exactly three problems (black at 1.0-2.53 s, freeze from 6.0 s, silence from 4.0 s).

notes: arsenal/media/audio.py qc(): one decode pass over a finished file: ebur128 + silencedetect on every audio track, blackdetect + freezedetect on a 320 px copy of the video (d3d11va decode), the stream inventory with exact packet counts (ffprobe -count_packets) and the duration; expect= {video_streams, audio_streams, duration_s, frames, w, h, fps, titles, I, I_tol, TP_max, no_black, no_freeze, no_silence} turns misses into one-line problems. The ffmpeg that arsenal.media.ff locates is a separate process whose licence depends on the build; the one saved on this machine is configured --enable-gpl --enable-version3, so it is not asserted here.
